Metadata.title: SafePaws — blueprints for cat shelters and water stations
Metadata.description: Open project: free blueprints for protective shelters and water stations for stray cats. Download DXF/PDF, build it yourself, or help in other ways.

Footer.ctaText: Every shelter is a chance at life.

About.heroDesc: SafePaws is an open project: blueprints and solutions so anyone can help street animals survive the winter with minimal effort.
About.howStarted1: In 2023, Pasha built one cat shelter near his apartment entrance. Then a second one. Then the neighbours asked for the blueprint.
About.howStarted2: That's how SafePaws was born — so that a blueprint that already exists can be downloaded and built by anyone.
About.howStarted3: Today the project has 2 shelter models, the PurrTap water station, and the EDC feeder in the pipeline.
About.authorQuote: "Started with one shelter by the entrance — now it's a project for everyone."
About.contactDesc: Question, suggestion, partnership — write us any way you like.

faqs.a: 6mm is stronger and warmer. 3mm — if you're cutting on a low-power laser.
Yes, any water-repellent sealant. Details in the PDF instructions.
Yes, see the stories above. The key is placing it where they already feel comfortable.

whyChoose.title: ✓ In a yard / by an entrance

assemblySteps.title: Assemble the body
assemblySteps.desc: Wood glue + screws. Has compartments — follow the diagram.

assemblySteps.title: Install and welcome cats

faqs.q: Can I do it without CNC?
faqs.a: Yes, but CNC makes cutting complex parts much easier.
4–5 comfortably. Up to 6–7 in freezing weather.
Absolutely — 6mm plywood absorbs moisture. Use any water-repellent varnish.

faqs.a: Depends on the temperature. Works above −15°C, below that you'll need heating.
